name: fluxzero-website
description: Public marketing website and technical documentation for Fluxzero

scripts.dev: pnpm sync:docs && astro sync && astro dev
scripts.build: pnpm sync:docs && astro sync && astro build && node scripts/inline-marketing-css.mjs && node scripts/protect-homepage-styles.mjs && node scripts/generate-llms.mjs && node scripts/sitemap-dates.mjs && node scripts/check-discovery.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs && node scripts/check-pricing-build.mjs
scripts.test:product-code: node tests/product-code/generate.mjs && mvn -B -f tests/product-code/pom.xml test && mvn -B -f tests/product-code/pom.xml -Pkotlin test
scripts.test:discovery: node --test scripts/check-discovery.test.mjs scripts/markdown-negotiation.test.mjs scripts/check-links.test.mjs scripts/remark-docs-links.test.mjs scripts/homepage-faq-history.test.mjs
scripts.test:website-oidc: node --test scripts/website-oidc-stub.test.mjs scripts/website-account-controls.test.mjs scripts/website-oidc-lifecycle.test.mjs scripts/website-oidc-navigation.test.mjs src/config/website-oidc.test.mjs
